Fact.Name: PA-40 line 1a gross compensation
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 10, LINE 1a: "The amount your employer reports in Box 16 of your Form W-2 usually shows your PA-taxable compensation if the W-2 includes PA withholding in Box 17." 72 P.S. §7303(a) (https://codes.findlaw.com/pa/title-72-ps-taxation-and-fiscal-affairs/pa-st-sect-72-7303/)(1) Compensation. Sum of W-2 box 16 (all W-2s are PA: a different-state W-2 knocks out via /flowKnockoutBox15IncomeFromDifferentState).

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 1b unreimbursed employee business expenses
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40.pdf line 1b. Not modeled (PA Schedule UE): $0; claiming it is covered by /flowKnockoutPaUnsupportedItems.

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 1c net compensation
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40.pdf line 1c: "Net Compensation. Subtract Line 1b from Line 1a."

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 2 interest income
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 14, LINE 2: "Report all PA-taxable interest income received or credited during the year." and "Interest income from direct obligations of the U.S. government, the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, and political subdivisions of Pennsylvania is tax exempt." Federal taxable interest minus 1099-INT box 3 (U.S. Savings Bonds and Treasury obligations). Box 8 tax-exempt interest knocks out (PA vs other-state munis not distinguished). 72 P.S. §7303(a) (https://codes.findlaw.com/pa/title-72-ps-taxation-and-fiscal-affairs/pa-st-sect-72-7303/)(6).

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 3 dividends
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 15, LINE 3: "Report all dividend income received or credited during 2025." Dividends are out of scope in this app (/ordinaryDividends = $0). 72 P.S. §7303(a) (https://codes.findlaw.com/pa/title-72-ps-taxation-and-fiscal-affairs/pa-st-sect-72-7303/)(5).

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 4 net business income
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40.pdf line 4. Schedule C businesses knock out (/flowKnockoutPaUnsupportedIncome), so $0. 72 P.S. §7303(a) (https://codes.findlaw.com/pa/title-72-ps-taxation-and-fiscal-affairs/pa-st-sect-72-7303/)(2).

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 5 net gain or loss from property
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 17, LINE 5: "Report your gain (loss) from the sale, exchange, or disposition of any kind of intangible property and any real or tangible property." and "PA law does not distinguish between long-term and short term gains (losses)". Sum of Form 8949 column (h); no federal $3,000 loss limit or carryover. May be negative (a net loss) — line 9 then ignores it. 72 P.S. §7303(a) (https://codes.findlaw.com/pa/title-72-ps-taxation-and-fiscal-affairs/pa-st-sect-72-7303/)(3).

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 6 rents, royalties, patents, copyrights
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40.pdf line 6. Schedule E income knocks out, so $0. 72 P.S. §7303(a) (https://codes.findlaw.com/pa/title-72-ps-taxation-and-fiscal-affairs/pa-st-sect-72-7303/)(4).

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 7 estate or trust income
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40.pdf line 7. Covered by /flowKnockoutPaUnsupportedItems, so $0. 72 P.S. §7303(a) (https://codes.findlaw.com/pa/title-72-ps-taxation-and-fiscal-affairs/pa-st-sect-72-7303/)(8).

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 8 gambling and lottery winnings
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40.pdf line 8. Covered by /flowKnockoutPaUnsupportedItems, so $0. 72 P.S. §7303(a) (https://codes.findlaw.com/pa/title-72-ps-taxation-and-fiscal-affairs/pa-st-sect-72-7303/)(7).

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 9 total PA taxable income
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 20, LINE 9: "Add only the positive income amounts from Lines 1c through 8. Do not add, subtract, or take losses into consideration." A net loss in one class never offsets another class.

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 10 other deductions
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 20, LINE 10 (MSA, HSA, 529, 529A ABLE; p. 1 notes the new Schedule O student loan interest deduction). Not modeled: $0; claiming any is covered by /flowKnockoutPaUnsupportedItems.

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 11 adjusted PA taxable income
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 21, LINE 11: "Subtract Line 10 from Line 9."

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 12 PA tax liability
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 21, LINE 12: "Multiply Line 11 by 3.07 percent (0.0307)." 72 P.S. §7302(a) (https://codes.findlaw.com/pa/title-72-ps-taxation-and-fiscal-affairs/pa-st-sect-72-7302/): "a tax upon each dollar of income received by that resident during that resident's taxable year at the rate of three and seven hundredths per cent."

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 13 total PA tax withheld
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 21, LINE 13: "Enter your total PA tax withheld from Box 17 of your federal Form(s) W2." 1099-INT state withholding knocks out (/flowKnockoutStateTaxWithheld); 1099-R/1099-MISC/W-2G knock out for PA.

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 24 total payments and credits
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 23, LINE 24: "Add Lines 13, 18, 21, 22, and 23." Lines 18 (estimated/extension payments, prior-year credit), 21 (Schedule SP), 22 (Schedule G-L resident credit) and 23 (Schedules OC/DC) are not modeled and are $0; each is a knockout.

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 26 tax due
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 23, LINE 26: "If the total of Line 12 and Line 25 is more than Line 24, enter the tax you owe." Line 25 use tax is $0 (knockout).

Fact.Name: PA-40 line 29 overpayment
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 24, LINE 29: "Subtract Line 12 (and subtract Lines 25 and 27, if you entered amounts on these lines) from Line 24, and enter the difference here."

Fact.Name: Has PA-40 items this tool doesn't support
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 (2025) line 1b (Schedule UE unreimbursed employee expenses), line 7 (estate/trust, Schedule J), line 8 (gambling/lottery, Schedule T), line 10 (MSA/HSA/529/ABLE/Schedule O deductions), lines 14-16 (prior-year credit, estimated and extension payments), line 22 (Schedule G-L credit for taxes paid to another state), line 23 (Schedules OC/DC credits), line 25 (use tax).

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: unsupported PA-40 items
Fact.Description: #78: yes to /paHasUnsupportedItems.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: income PA-40 core does not classify
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 17 (LINE 4 business, PA Schedule C), p. 17-19 (LINE 6 rents, Schedule E), pp. 13-14 (1099-R: PA taxability depends on plan/age/code), 1099-MISC (must be classified), box 8 tax-exempt interest (PA taxes other states' obligations, exempts PA ones: p. 14), W-2 with wages but no box 16 PA wages, and joint returns with property sales (p. 7: "You may not offset the income of the taxpayer with a loss from the spouse and vice versa", not modeled).

Fact.Name: Highest Schedule SP eligibility income that gets any forgiveness
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf p. 39, Eligibility Income Table 1 (Unmarried): 100% at "$6,500" stepping by $250 to 10% at $8,750, and each dependent child adds $9,500 (1 child: "$16,000" at 100%, $18,250 at 10%). Table 2 (Married): 100% at $13,000 up to 10% at $15,250, +$9,500 per child (1 child "$22,500" at 100%).

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: may qualify for PA Tax Forgiveness (Schedule SP)
Fact.Description: #78: PA-40 IN (2025), https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf pp. 36-39: Schedule SP (line 21) is not computed until #79. Eligibility income includes PA-taxable income, so if line 11 is at or below the highest table amount the filer could qualify; block rather than overstate tax.
